name: Honey-Dijon Arugula Salad with Chickpeas, Potatoes & Pear
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Quarter potatoes and transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Drain and rinse chickpeas in the colander; add to the baking sheet. Drizzle potatoes and chickpeas with oil, season with spices, and toss to coat. Spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until potatoes are fork-tender and chickpeas are crisp, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice pears; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Roughly chop pecans, add to the bowl, and set aside.
When the potatoes and chickpeas are done, add to the bowl, along with the arugula, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
